content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket carefully.

Belinda Fuentes (E039) requests admin access to Payroll.

There are two conflicting notes:
- Note 1: full-time Analyst, recommendation: write. Says role does not own Payroll so admin not permitted, granting write.
- Note 2: contractor with basic security training, recommendation: read. Says Security record is authoritative, contractors never admin, write requires advanced training, granting read.

The notes conflict on employment type. Note 2 explicitly says the Security record is authoritative and that the earlier note listed full_time but Security record is authoritative.

So the employee is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin. This employee has basic training, so maximum is read.

Requested level: admin. Maximum: read. Since requested is above maximum, grant maximum = read.

Let me submit decision: read.

Evidence: Employee is contractor with basic security training (per authoritative Security record). Contractors never admin; write requires advanced training. Requested admin exceeds the max allowed level of read. Grant read.
